title: Zephyr: Root signature in DIO
notes: Needs design decision: DODAG ID should be AddrForKey(root_pubkey) per spec 8.4, but current implementation uses hardcoded ULA (fd00::1). Required changes: (1) API to expose L2 Yggdrasil address, (2) update gateway_rpl_init() to use it, (3) coordinate with sibling task l1qw.6.9.2.4 for verification side. L2 signing of DIOs is already implemented at L2 layer.
